# coolify_scheduled_task (Resource)

A scheduled task (cron job) executed inside an application's or service's container (docs: knowledge-base/cron-syntax).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_scheduled_task" "cleanup" {
  parent_type = "application"
  parent_uuid = coolify_application.web.uuid
  name        = "nightly-cleanup"
  command     = "php artisan cache:clear"
  frequency   = "0 3 * * *"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Command to run.
- `frequency` (String) Cron expression (`0 3 * * *`) or shorthand (`@daily`, `@hourly`…).
- `name` (String) Task name.
- `parent_type` (String) `application` or `service`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `parent_uuid` (String) UUID of the parent resource. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `container` (String) Container to run in (for multi-container compose resources).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the task is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
